note: Live dev environment. Retail units US and GB. Each check drives the real UI and compares what is rendered against the same API call the page made. This run adds seven new areas: cross-level aggregation, API-failure resilience, cold-load deep links, week-by-week chart values, PA ordering, other-metric toggles, and a second retail unit.
